name: Wuhan YZY Biopharma Co Ltd
summary: Wuhan YZY Biopharma Co., Ltd., established in 2010 and headquartered in Wuhan, develops treatments based on bispecific antibodies. It targets cancers and cancer complications, such as malignant ascites and pleural effusion, solid tumors, small cell lung cancer and multiple myeloma, as well as age-related eye conditions like wet macular degeneration and diabetic macular edema. It is also advancing therapies for COVID-19.
